initiative.title: Local data file inputs
initiative.summary: Research local formats and propose small input readers that preserve table meaning.
initiative.next_action: Review the proposed scope and first proof before authorizing implementation planning.

sources.anchor: Full request; named formats and no-API Sheets boundary
Executive recommendation; landscape; deep dives; repository findings

sources.authority: Pro landscape with primary source anchors

sources.anchor: Repository checks; Decisive external checks; Recommendation dispositions

claims.statement: Understand common and niche formats used by data analysis tools.
Add direct TSV, XLSX, Parquet, and Avro support through proved subsets.
Use Google Sheets manual exports; defer APIs, OAuth, and live connectors.
Preserve raw research and produce intent and shaping docs in a review PR.
A small shared demo reader is enough; a public plugin platform is unnecessary.
Admitted values must retain meaning through actual consumers and persistence.
Keep database, transport, and local-file initiatives distinct.
Add strict flat JSON Lines; retain niche formats as conversion guidance.
Include load-data docs and an example in each user-visible format slice.

conflicts.issue: Pro labels Avro demand-gated despite the explicit request.
conflicts.resolution: Treat the request as demand; retain an explicit OCF feasibility proof. Browser and codec gates still apply.

conflicts.issue: Research proposes extensive quotas, fixtures, and compatibility details.
conflicts.resolution: Retain demonstrated behavior risks and few important tests. No parallel version support or generic import framework.

shape.appetite: Public library reader API with optional lazy readers for CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines, XLSX, Parquet, and Arrow/Feather; source fidelity fixed for every reader. Implementation not yet authorized.
shape.problem: CSV/JSON initial import and CSV-only Add source diverge; new readers can lose values in existing inference and save paths.

recommended_shape.location: packages/explorEDA (public reader API), consumed by the demo
recommended_shape.boundary: File and format-specific options -> complete rows and the field interpretation required by existing consumers.
recommended_shape.workbooks: Separate discovery/selection helper for one sheet, rectangle, and header; one source per action.
recommended_shape.library: Keep row arrays. Readers return rows plus declared field types; optional peer dependencies load on demand.

alternatives.name: Conversion only
alternatives.disposition: Useful for niche formats; misses requested direct imports.

alternatives.name: Demo-local dispatch
alternatives.disposition: Superseded 2026-10-13: readers must be available to all package users.

alternatives.name: Public input adapter package
alternatives.disposition: Selected 2026-10-13 as a library API inside exploreda, without a plugin registry.

alternatives.name: DuckDB-Wasm or universal Arrow intermediate
alternatives.disposition: Rejected 2026-10-13: one reader library per format chosen.

success_moves: Prove exact text, missing values, late fields, and saved state through real consumers before adding binary dependencies.
Reuse installed Papa with explicit TSV options; avoid a second delimiter parser.
Share initial and Add source dispatch while keeping project restore distinct.
Isolate optional readers so a failed proof does not affect existing imports.
Use independent producer fixtures and production builds for workbook and binary fidelity.
Ship docs and one working example with each enabled format.

first_proof.question: Can TSV retain its declared table meaning through initial import, Add source, exploration, and all used save routes?
first_proof.artifact: A deterministic TSV fixture, expected values, and browser evidence for both import paths, filters, trace, and restore.
first_proof.observation: Leading-zero and unsafe-integer text, quoted tabs, missingness, date-like strings, and a field populated after row 500 remain correct. Tabs and layouts survive.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed only on value and field parity through every exercised path. Repair the failing consumer narrowly or reject unsupported values before enabling more readers.

rabbit_holes: Implicit nested flattening or sheet merging

dependencies.name: Papa Parse 5.5.2
dependencies.application_seam: Explicit TSV tokenization in the shared demo reader
failure_modes: Automatic coercion changes identifiers and dates
Malformed headers or async File errors

first_proof_role.rationale: The installed parser serves the first TSV proof.

dependencies.local_proof: Text and File fixtures plus actual exploration and restore.
dependencies.live_proof: Browser import at wide, intermediate, and narrow widths; no provider account.
dependencies.rollout: Enable TSV after consumer parity; preserve current CSV behavior.

dependencies.name: Existing row consumers and persistence
dependencies.application_seam: Reader output into initial data and project tables
dependencies.local_proof: Exercise settings, promotion, cache/history, and project-file round trips.
dependencies.live_proof: Real UI consumers; mocked workspace tests alone are insufficient.
dependencies.rollout: Repair the observed path; no universal serializer.

dependencies.name: JSON Lines numeric parser candidate
dependencies.application_seam: Line decoding before ordinary JavaScript number conversion

first_proof_role.rationale: TSV proves rows before another parser.

dependencies.local_proof: Evaluate a small lossless parser with independent text fixtures and Vite build.
dependencies.live_proof: No service; production browser smoke for the chosen artifact.
dependencies.rollout: Enable flat-object JSONL only; retain existing JSON policy.

dependencies.name: XLSX candidate: SheetJS CE

first_proof_role.rationale: Workbook selection follows the TSV proof.

dependencies.local_proof: Pin official artifact; compare real Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets fixtures against expected cells.
dependencies.live_proof: Production build, selection, failure/cancel, and responsiveness; no live API.
dependencies.rollout: One rectangle; other workbook extensions disabled. Compare ExcelJS for a concrete failure.

dependencies.name: Parquet candidate: hyparquet
dependencies.application_seam: Local bytes and schema inspection before decoder conversion

first_proof_role.rationale: Binary decoding waits for proven row semantics.

dependencies.local_proof: Independent single-file fixtures; selected types and codecs.
dependencies.live_proof: Production browser and codec asset checks; measure total import cost.
dependencies.rollout: Enable proved subsets; compare parquet-wasm only for a required failing case.

dependencies.name: Avro OCF reader candidate
dependencies.application_seam: OCF and writer schema into admitted scalar rows

first_proof_role.rationale: Avro is requested, but its browser container path needs proof.

dependencies.local_proof: Pin a stable candidate; independent null/deflate OCF fixtures; exact long and union checks.
dependencies.live_proof: Real production browser policy; do not weaken policy to pass.
dependencies.rollout: If no bounded candidate passes, retain conversion guidance and failed-proof evidence.

dependencies.name: Google Sheets manual exports
dependencies.application_seam: Exported file through its ordinary reader

first_proof_role.rationale: The TSV core proof needs no online dependency.

dependencies.local_proof: Retain producer exports with expected sheet, row, and value results.
dependencies.live_proof: A few manually exported two-sheet fixtures during implementation. No OAuth or APIs.
dependencies.rollout: Advertise only exported formats whose own readers pass; no sync promise.

fast_local_loop.policy: Few important behavior tests and independent fixtures; exact package/browser proofs remain separate.
